svg.text: The worker calls Scorch.Batch(), which fans
our 200 docs out to the analysis queue and
encodes the results into one in-memory
Our batch is now an in-memory segment of
200 docs. It goes to the one goroutine
allowed to change the index root: the introducer.
It builds a new root snapshot with our
segment appended, swaps it in, and bumps
the epoch to 1,042. From now on, searches
cbft sets a 2s nap, so in-memory segments
pile up and get merged before they’re
